leak_breakdown_and_primary_leak_driver_f.finding: unit_net_margin's real formula (price - cogs - shipping - return_cost, confirmed in Prompt 2) never includes refund_amount/discount_amount/processing_fees/allocated_ad_spend at all -- yet leak_breakdown displays 4 of its 5 fields (returns_cost=order.refund_amount, discount_cost, processing_fees, ad_spend) as if they explain the margin shortfall, when none of them are actually inputs to unit_net_margin's formula. The true dominant real cost, unit_cogs (32,088,000, ~93% of this SKU's total real costs), is completely absent from leak_breakdown and can never be selected as primary_leak_driver. The endpoint selected 'returns_cost' (1,120,000, a real refund total but causally unrelated to this SKU's margin formula) as the primary driver, when COGS -- not shown at all -- is the actual overwhelming cause. NEW issue E4-2 (High), logged once in QA_ISSUES.md.
leak_breakdown_and_primary_leak_driver_f.cross_reference: E2-1 (unit_net_margin omits processing_fees/allocated_ad_spend) is the root cause of the formula gap that made this discoverable; E4-2 is a distinct, new finding about leak_breakdown's own disconnected field set, not a duplicate of E2-1.

unit_return_cost_persistence_finding.finding: Confirmed via direct SQL: 0 of 1,964 order_items for this merchant have a non-null unit_return_cost, even though 982 of them (the second Prompt-2 ingestion pass) demonstrably had a real 500-per-unit return cost applied to their margin (unit_net_margin exactly 500xquantity lower than their first-pass counterparts, per Prompt 2's own data). Root-caused to a variable-shadowing bug at write_canonical_rows (app/services/ecommerce_ingestion.py:332): the persisted item_fields dict re-reads row['unit_return_cost'] (the original, pre-resolution source value) instead of the local, already-resolved unit_return_cost variable used moments earlier to compute unit_net_margin. NEW issue E4-1 (High), logged once in QA_ISSUES.md.

summary: All 3 diagnostic endpoints are implemented, schema-compliant, and RBAC-gated. profit-leaks' total_leaking_skus/total_margin_at_risk and dead-stock's dead_sku_count both matched independent recomputation exactly. Two significant new defects discovered via close inspection of profit-leaks' explanatory fields: E4-1 (unit_return_cost persists the wrong, unresolved value due to a variable-shadowing bug) and E4-2 (leak_breakdown/primary_leak_driver omits COGS -- the true dominant cost -- and includes 4 fields with no actual causal connection to the margin being explained). return-forensics confirmed empty, directly proving E2-3's predicted impact.
